question: In 2021, who among the following was awarded the 12th Kalasagar Awards for exemplary contribution to the field of Mohiniyattam?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Sandhya Rajan__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sandhya Rajan**

 
 
• In collaboration with the** Kunnamkulam Kathakali Club **and the Ministry of Culture, Government of India, the **Kalasagar Awards for outstanding** contributions to traditional performing arts for the years 2020 and 2021 will now be given out on December 5, 2021 at the Badhani School in** Kunnamkulam, Thrissur.**
 
• **Vesham, Music, Chenda, Maddalam, and Chutty, **as well as those who excel in Bharathanatyam, Mohiniyattom, Kuchipudi, Ottenthullal, Chakyarkoothu, Koodiyattom, Thayambaka, and Panchavadyam —** Thimila, Maddalam, Edakka**, Thalam, and Kombu— are recognised with **Kalasagar awards.**
 
• **The state of Kerala **is where the Indian classical dance style known as mohiniyattam was born and has since flourished.
 
• At the age of five,** Sandhya began studying Bharatanatyam and Mohiniyattam** with her instructor and grandmother Kalamandalam Kalyani Kutty Amma. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__​​​**

 
• Krishna Panicker

 
 
• Madhavi Amma and a well-known Nattuvan from Korattikkara named Appuredath** Krishna Panicker joined Kalamandalam in 1938**.
 
• During this period, **Vallathol convinced Kalyanikutty Amma to take Mohiniyattam lessons.**
 
 
 
• Sunanda Nair
 
 
• Indian dancer** Sunanda Nair** has received training in mohiniattam.
 
• She received her master's degree in this dance style from the University of Mumbai-affiliated** Nalanda Nritya Kala Mahavidyalaya.**
 
 
 
• Gopika Rajan
 
 
• Mohiniyattam dancer and teacher **Gopika Rajan was born in Kerala and now resides in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. ​**
